newsitem.title: ROMANIA: World Bank yet to unlock Romania credit.
newsitem.headline: World Bank yet to unlock Romania credit.

text.p: The World Bank has still to approve the resumption of $80 million in credits to Romania intended to help the country restructure industry, the Bank's resident representative in Bucharest said on Wednesday.
Francois Ettori told a private television station that the Bank's Board would consider the restoration of the funds, part of a Financial and Enterprise Structural Adjustment Loan (FESAL), by Friday.

The Bank's Board approved a package of credits for Romania in Washington on Wednesday worth $550 million. Those credits were intended to support farm reform, social security and improvements to Romania's dilapidated road network.
